# particles.js 2.0.0

Vendored from Vincent Garreau's particles.js repository:
https://github.com/VincentGarreau/particles.js/blob/master/particles.min.js

Upstream Git blob: `b3d46d127fce3c8c3d2cb8a234a6d3f7bb8bbcaf`.
The original minified code is unchanged. The MIT license is included in `LICENSE.md`.

The website serves this local copy so particle backgrounds do not depend on a
third-party CDN being available. Particle settings remain in `static/js/common.js`.
